states.text: Unavailable — no current source; never shown as zero.
Stale — retained value with age, never current.
Conflict — compare candidate sources before use.
Partial — valid siblings and PV/BMS counter/loss evidence stay visible.
Withdrawn — a prior candidate was withdrawn.
Withheld — projection intentionally omits the value.
Invalid contribution — isolated from other drivers.

actions.text: Unauthorized discovery: HVAC mode action is hidden.

HVAC setpoint has current capability, authority, route and deadline admitted.
